responsibility: Defines regression tests and microbenchmarks for the bit-set implementations in this module, validating the observable behavior and invariants of `BitSet`, `HybridBitSet`, and `ChunkedBitSet` across construction, iteration, cloning, set operations, range insertion, search helpers, empty/full edge cases, and representation transitions, while also measuring performance of common update and union paths.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `tests.rs` files, this one exercises the crate's bitmap-backed set implementations and their representation-specific behavior, including `BitSet`, `HybridBitSet`, and `ChunkedBitSet`, plus benchmark coverage for union and update operations. It is the only same-named test file focused on dense/sparse bitset mechanics and performance rather than interval merging semantics or newtype-index APIs.
